mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, plan_id AS planId, plan_code_snapshot AS planCodeSnapshot, plan_version_snapshot AS planVersionSnapshot, price_vnd_snapshot AS priceVndSnapshot, price_xu_snapshot AS priceXuSnapshot, accepted_plan_version AS acceptedPlanVersion, tickets_per_period_snapshot AS ticketsPerPeriodSnapshot, period_months_snapshot AS periodMonthsSnapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot AS ticketValidityDaysSnapshot, start_at AS startAt, current_period_start AS currentPeriodStart, current_period_end AS currentPeriodEnd, next_renewal_at AS nextRenewalAt, next_grant_at AS nextGrantAt, end_at AS endAt, status, auto_renew AS autoRenew, primary_funding_source AS primaryFundingSource, fallback_funding_source AS fallbackFundingSource, price_consent_at AS priceConsentAt, cancel_requested_at AS cancelRequestedAt, source_type AS sourceType, source_ref AS sourceRef, policy_version AS policyVersion, version

id, subscription_id AS subscriptionId, user_id AS userId, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, grace_end_at AS graceEndAt, plan_version_snapshot AS planVersionSnapshot, price_vnd_snapshot AS priceVndSnapshot, price_xu_snapshot AS priceXuSnapshot, status, attempt_count AS attemptCount, next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, settled_source AS settledSource, settled_reference AS settledReference, settled_at AS settledAt, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND auto_renew=1 AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE') AND next_renewal_at<=#{now} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reading_subscription SET auto_renew=0, next_renewal_at=NULL, end_at=current_period_end, status='PENDING_PRICE_CONSENT', cancel_requested_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND auto_renew=1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_subscription_renewal_cycle (subscription_id, user_id, period_start, period_end, grace_end_at, plan_version_snapshot, price_vnd_snapshot, price_xu_snapshot, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{subscription.id}, #{subscription.userId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{graceEndAt}, #{subscription.planVersionSnapshot}, #{subscription.priceVndSnapshot}, #{subscription.priceXuSnapshot}, 'DUE', 0, #{now}, #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reading_subscription_renewal_cycle WHERE status=#{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE status='PAST_DUE'
SELECT FROM reading_subscription_renewal_cycle WHERE id=#{cycleId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_subscription_renewal_attempt (cycle_id, attempt_no, funding_source, status, request_hash, started_at) VALUES (#{cycleId}, #{attemptNo}, #{fundingSource}, #{status}, #{requestHash}, #{now})

INSERT INTO reading_subscription_renewal_attempt (cycle_id, attempt_no, funding_source, provider_request_id, status, request_hash, started_at) VALUES (#{cycleId}, #{attemptNo}, 'VNPAY_RECURRING', #{providerRequestId}, 'STARTED', #{requestHash}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_cycle SET status='PROCESSING', attempt_count=#{attemptNo}, next_attempt_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{cycleId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('DUE', 'RETRY_WAIT')
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS cycleId, c.subscription_id AS subscriptionId, c.user_id AS userId, a.attempt_no AS attemptNo, c.price_vnd_snapshot AS amountVnd, c.period_start AS periodStart, a.provider_request_id AS providerRequestId, m.provider_recurring_id AS providerRecurringId, m.provider_token_ciphertext AS providerTokenCiphertext, m.token_expire_at AS tokenExpireAt FROM reading_subscription_renewal_cycle c JOIN reading_subscription_renewal_attempt a ON a.cycle_id=c.id AND a.attempt_no=c.attempt_count AND a.status='STARTED' LEFT JOIN reading_subscription_mandate m ON m.user_id=c.user_id AND m.provider='VNPAY_RECURRING' AND m.status='ACTIVE' WHERE c.id=#{cycleId} AND c.status='PROCESSING' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_attempt SET status='SETTLED', provider_transaction_id=#{reference}, completed_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE cycle_id=#{cycleId} AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo} AND status='STARTED'

UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_cycle SET status='SETTLED', attempt_count=attempt_count+1, settled_source=#{fundingSource}, settled_reference=#{reference}, settled_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{cycleId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('DUE', 'RETRY_WAIT')

UPDATE user_reading_subscription SET current_period_start=#{cycle.periodStart}, current_period_end=#{cycle.periodEnd}, next_renewal_at=#{cycle.periodEnd}, end_at=NULL, status='ACTIVE', version=version+1 WHERE id=#{cycle.subscriptionId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND auto_renew=1 AND current_period_end=#{cycle.periodStart}

UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_cycle SET status='PROVIDER_PENDING', attempt_count=#{attemptNo}, version=version+1, next_attempt_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{cycleId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_attempt SET status='UNKNOWN', response_code=#{responseCode}, completed_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE cycle_id=#{cycleId} AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo} AND status='STARTED'

UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_attempt SET status='FAILED', response_code=#{responseCode}, completed_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE cycle_id=#{cycleId} AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo} AND status='STARTED'
UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_cycle SET status='RETRY_WAIT', next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{cycleId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_attempt SET status='SETTLED', provider_transaction_id=#{reference}, completed_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE cycle_id=#{cycleId} AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo} AND status='STARTED'

UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_cycle SET status='SETTLED', settled_source='VNPAY_RECURRING', settled_reference=#{reference}, settled_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{cycleId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_attempt SET status='FAILED', response_message=#{message}, completed_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE cycle_id=#{cycleId} AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo} AND status='STARTED'

UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_cycle SET status='RETRY_WAIT', attempt_count=#{attemptCount}, next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{cycleId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('DUE', 'RETRY_WAIT')
UPDATE user_reading_subscription SET status='PAST_DUE', version=version+1 WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE') AND auto_renew=1
UPDATE reading_subscription_renewal_cycle SET status='GRACE_EXPIRED', version=version+1 WHERE id=#{cycleId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('DUE', 'RETRY_WAIT')

UPDATE user_reading_subscription SET auto_renew=0, primary_funding_source=NULL, fallback_funding_source=NULL, next_renewal_at=NULL, end_at=current_period_end, status='CANCELLED', cancel_requested_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE')
mapper.select: SELECT cycle.id AS cycleId, cycle.subscription_id AS subscriptionId, cycle.user_id AS userId, subscription.plan_code_snapshot AS planCode, cycle.status, cycle.attempt_count AS attemptCount, cycle.next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, cycle.grace_end_at AS graceEndAt, cycle.price_vnd_snapshot AS priceVnd, cycle.price_xu_snapshot AS priceXu, attempt.funding_source AS fundingSource, attempt.status AS attemptStatus, attempt.response_code AS responseCode, attempt.provider_transaction_id AS providerTransactionId, attempt.update_time AS attemptUpdatedAt, cycle.version FROM reading_subscription_renewal_cycle cycle JOIN user_reading_subscription subscription ON subscription.id=cycle.subscription_id LEFT JOIN reading_subscription_renewal_attempt attempt ON attempt.cycle_id=cycle.id AND attempt.attempt_no=cycle.attempt_count WHERE cycle.status=#{status} ORDER BY cycle.update_time ASC, cycle.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, cycle_id AS cycleId, attempt_no AS attemptNo, funding_source AS fundingSource, provider_request_id AS providerRequestId, provider_transaction_id AS providerTransactionId, status, response_code AS responseCode, response_message AS responseMessage, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, version FROM reading_subscription_renewal_attempt WHERE cycle_id=#{cycleId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, cycle_id AS cycleId, user_id AS userId, operator_id AS operatorId, action, before_status AS beforeStatus, after_status AS afterStatus, reason, create_time AS createTime FROM reading_subscription_renewal_admin_audit WHERE cycle_id=#{cycleId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
